note: Two things read from each speaker's own page on the event site, frozen and hashed like every other source. TOPICS are the event's own tag list for that speaker, verbatim. TAGS are derived: each is a lexicon entry (data/lexicon.json, a published regular expression) that matched the page's Bio prose, and carries the matched words and nothing else. A tag says the page contains these words; it is not a characterisation of the person. bio_chars is the length of the prose the lexicon ran over, kept so a reader can see how much text a tag stands on.
